// Pixel art for the desktop view: one set per playful theme, each a palette and text
// grids ("." is clear), drawn as SVG squares with crisp edges. Every set fills the
// same slots, so the view asks for "done" or "workflow" and each theme answers with
// its own picture: kitty's cats, fish on lines, dogs on walks. Each state reads by
// its outline at 16 px; failed and quiet lie down where the sprite has a body to lay.
export const SLOTS = ['walk0', 'walk1', 'walk2', 'walk3', 'done', 'failed', 'stopped', 'quiet', 'workflow', 'group', 'scene'] as const
export type Slot = typeof SLOTS[number]
export type ArtSet = { pal: Record<string, string>; pix: Record<Slot, readonly string[]> }
export type ArtName = 'kitty' | 'fish' | 'dog'
